slides.title: Diesel carries the Gulf premium

blocks.text: Before the carrier report, the Gulf energy premium sat in Gulf Coast diesel margins rather than Brent — and no crude or diesel price since has tested whether that split holds.
blocks.sub: Governing thesis of The Read, 2026-10-02 AM edition [S1]

slides.takeaway: The energy shock is showing up in refined products, not crude — The Read holds this lean with low confidence until new prices print.
